FX-XFORM-001.says: As added: the anchor point and position at the middle, scale 100, no skew or rotation, opacity 100: the drawing, untouched.

FX-XFORM-002.says: Position (75, 50): the drawing four pixels right inside its layer; its left four columns clear and its right four cut off, the layer never growing.

FX-XFORM-003.says: Position (53.125, 50): half a pixel right, each pixel the even mix of itself and the one to its left.

FX-XFORM-004.says: Scale Height 50 with Uniform Scale on, Scale Width 200 not read: the drawing at half size round the middle, in columns 4 to 11 and rows 2 to 7.

FX-XFORM-005.says: Uniform Scale off, Scale Width 50, Scale Height 100: squeezed to half its width round the middle, its full height kept.

FX-XFORM-006.says: Rotation 90: a quarter turn clockwise round the middle; column x of the frame is row 12 - x of the drawing, cut to the layer.

FX-XFORM-007.says: Rotation 30, bilinear sampling: turned a twelfth, soft at the stripes' edges.

FX-XFORM-008.says: Rotation 30, bicubic sampling: the same turn, the stripes' edges crisper than FX-XFORM-007.

FX-XFORM-009.says: Skew 30 along axis 0: the rows slide sideways, the top ones right and the lower ones left, round the middle row; the stripes lean.

FX-XFORM-010.says: Skew 30 along axis 90: the columns slide up and down instead; the blue band leans.

FX-XFORM-011.says: Anchor point and position (0, 0), rotation 45: an eighth turn round the drawing's top left corner, half of it swung off the layer.

FX-XFORM-012.says: Opacity 50: every pixel at half its covering.

FX-XFORM-013.says: Scale Height -100, uniform: turned over both ways, the same as rotation 180.

FX-XFORM-014.says: Scale Height 0: nothing left, the frame clear.

FX-XFORM-015.says: Position keyed from (50, 50) at frame 0 to (100, 50) at frame 4, linear, no motion blur: two pixels further right each frame.

FX-XFORM-016.says: FX-XFORM-015 with the layer's motion blur switch on and the composition's blur enabled at 180 degrees, phase -90, 4 samples: frame 2 is the mean of the slide at 1.8125, 1.9375, 2.0625 and 2.1875, a streak a pixel long.

FX-XFORM-017.says: FX-XFORM-016 with the layer's switch off: no blur, as FX-XFORM-015.

FX-XFORM-018.says: FX-XFORM-016 with the composition's blur not enabled: no blur.

FX-XFORM-019.says: FX-XFORM-016 with Use Composition's Shutter Angle off and Shutter Angle 360, centred on the frame: the moments 1.625, 1.875, 2.125 and 2.375, at twice the spacing round 2, a streak two pixels long.

FX-XFORM-020.says: FX-XFORM-019 with Shutter Angle 0: no blur, as FX-XFORM-015.

FX-XFORM-021.says: Rotation 30, not keyed, with the layer's and composition's blur on: nothing moves through the shutter, so no blur, as FX-XFORM-007.

FX-XFORM-022.says: Rotation keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 90 at frame 4 with the blur on, bicubic: frame 2 is the mean of four turns round 45 degrees, a spin blur.

FX-XFORM-023.says: Position (75, 50) on the layer moved three pixels right: the effect works inside the layer, so FX-XFORM-002 moved three more.

FX-XFORM-024.says: Motion Tile at 300% by 300% first, then rotation 90: the points are the drawing's own, so the tiles turn round the drawing's middle and fill the frame.

FX-XFORM-025.says: Bicubic sampling with the settings as added: the drawing, untouched.

FX-XFORM-026.says: Skew 86, above 85. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-XFORM-027.says: Opacity 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-XFORM-028.says: Position keyed to (1200, 50) at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-XFORM-029.says: Shutter Angle 361, above 360. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-XFORM-030.says: Uniform Scale written "yes". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-XFORM-031.says: Sampling written "nearest". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-XFORM-032.says: Use Composition's Shutter Angle written "maybe". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
